ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) central region vs 35% high-intensity (white) lateral regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region (approx. 60% width) is solid low-intensity black. Lateral distal tips contain high-intensity white patches. Right lobe white patch contains a distinctive J-shaped dark pixel cluster and several vertical linear streaks. Left lobe white patch exhibits dense dark mottling and speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary featuring high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. A significant indentation/notch is visible on the far left distal edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves tapering from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, isolated high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (approx. 5-10 count) scattered across the dark central and medial regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent J-shaped dark mark on the right lobe white patch. Multiple vertical and diagonal dark linear streaks (rake marks) crossing the white patches on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive J-shaped pigmentation mark or scar on the upper-mid section of the right lobe's white surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The right-side 'J' mark is the primary distinctive geometric identifier.
